title: Bayesian Wombling for Tracking Invasive Species
summary: North American invasive-species applications report modeled occurrence gradients and curvature, including supported and null intervals. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: A hierarchical Gaussian process models occurrence fields and differentiates them to estimate species-specific boundaries.
